items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there were three sisters before that. Let’s see, I think their names were Hazel, Blossom

ctx.x: So I know having done some research about your background, I know that you’re one of, you’re the youngest of three brothers, surviving three children of six.

Yes, I am the youngest. My other brother, the middle brother, was Donald Burrell. And the oldest brother was William Henry, Jr. and there were three sisters before that. Let’s see, I think their names were Hazel, Blossom, and I can’t think of the other one at the moment.
